system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: gke-cluster.jinja

resources:
  - name: production-gke-cluster
    type: gke-cluster.jinja
    properties:
      clusterName: production-cluster
      clusterLocation: us-central1
      initialNodeCount: 3
      nodeMachineType: e2-standard-4
      nodeDiskSizeGb: 100
      nodeDiskType: pd-standard
      nodeImageType: COS_CONTAINERD
      nodeServiceAccount: default
      nodeOauthScopes:
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/devstorage.read_only
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/logging.write
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/service.management.readonly
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/servicecontrol
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/trace.append
      network: default
      subnetwork: default
      clusterIpv4Cidr: /14
      servicesIpv4Cidr: /20
      enablePrivateNodes: false
      enablePrivateEndpoint: false
      masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      enableNetworkPolicy: true
      enableIntranodeVisibility: true
      enableVerticalPodAutoscaling: true
      enableAutoscaling: true
      minNodeCount: 3
      maxNodeCount: 10
      enableAutoRepair: true
      enableAutoUpgrade: true
      enableMasterAuthorizedNetworks: false
      masterAuthorizedNetworksConfig:
        - cidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
          displayName: Allow all (not recommended)
      enableLegacyAbac: false
      enableShieldedNodes: true
      enableBinaryAuthorization: false
      enablePodSecurityPolicy: false
      enableResourceUsageExport: true
      enableStackdriverKubernetes: true
      enableWorkloadIdentity: false
      workloadIdentityConfig:
        identityNamespace: ""
      nodePoolName: production-pool
      nodePoolInitialNodeCount: 3
      nodePoolAutoscaling:
        enabled: true
        minNodeCount: 3
        maxNodeCount: 10
      nodePoolManagement:
        autoRepair: true
        autoUpgrade: true
      nodePoolConfig:
        machineType: e2-standard-4
        diskSizeGb: 100
        diskType: pd-standard
        imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
        serviceAccount: default
        oauthScopes:
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/devstorage.read_only
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/logging.write
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/service.management.readonly
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/servicecontrol
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/trace.append
        labels:
          environment: production
        tags:
          - production
          - gke-node
        shieldedInstanceConfig:
          enableSecureBoot: true
          enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
        reservationAffinity:
          consumeReservationType: NO_RESERVATION
